slides.title: Whole-Body Dexterity
slides.highlight: This work demonstrates a sim-to-real framework for humanoid robots to use their entire body, including torso and arms, as contact surfaces for dexterous manipulation, achieving high success rates in complex repositioning tasks.

card.one_liner: Whole-Body Dexterity enables humanoids to manipulate objects using arms and torso, achieving 90% real-world success.
card.key_idea: Generates whole-body grasp datasets, trains RL experts for repositioning, and distills them into a policy using proprioception and object geometry.
card.evaluation: Tested on Unitree G1 with basketballs and boxes; outperformed GMR (18%) and SONIC (4%) with 90% success in real-world tasks.
card.limitation: Requires a skilled human teleoperator for coarse motion references; leg-based grasps are excluded from current training.

slides.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
slides.highlight: This benchmark evaluates how embodied agents learn and generalize user preferences in manipulation tasks, addressing the challenge of adapting general-purpose robots to specific household needs.

card.one_liner: LIBERO-PeRM benchmarks personalized robotic manipulation, revealing current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot preference adherence.
card.key_idea: A simulation benchmark with a taxonomy of motion, skill, and user-profile preferences, featuring procedural data generation and automated satisfaction metrics.
card.evaluation: Tested six VLA policies on 312 tasks using success and satisfaction rates; results show SFT enables learning but generalization and conflict handling remain difficult.
card.limitation: Restricted to language-expressible, simulation-based preferences; excludes implicit inference, non-linguistic signals, and open-ended preferences lacking automatic metrics.

slides.title: REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs
slides.highlight: REKI demonstrates that a compact vision-language-action model can achieve high performance by integrating a lightweight memory mechanism using register tokens, which reduces pose oscillations and improves success rates in both simulation and real-world robot tasks.

card.one_liner: REKI is a 2.4B VLA using register-based memory to achieve state-of-the-art performance on public data.
card.key_idea: Pairs a VLM with a flow-matching action expert, using cached register tokens to efficiently summarize past frames for temporal context.
card.evaluation: Tested on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboCasa365; outperforms public-data baselines and reduces oscillations by 4x.
card.limitation: Performance trails larger models using proprietary data or video-generation supervision in some in-distribution tasks.

slides.title: Policy-Aligned Predictive Verification for Adaptive VLA Action-Chunk Execution
slides.highlight: This work introduces a policy-aligned predictive verifier that assesses the compatibility of Vision-Language-Action model action prefixes with successful task completion, improving execution-horizon selection without relying on generation stability signals.

card.one_liner: PAV predicts future VLA states to verify action prefixes, enabling adaptive execution horizons that improve success rates.
card.key_idea: Policy-aligned predictive verifier predicts future VLA representations to assess prefix validity, using trajectory supervision and localization priors.
card.evaluation: Tested on π0/π0.5 across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, showing improved success-query trade-offs versus baselines.
card.limitation: Requires collecting rollouts for training and adds minor computational overhead for prediction and verification during execution.

slides.title: DemoStream: Batched Task-and-Motion-Plan Optimization for Automated Learning from Demonstration
slides.highlight: DemoStream uses GPU-accelerated batched Task and Motion Planning to generate high-quality demonstrations for behavior cloning, addressing multi-modality issues in automated skill acquisition.

card.one_liner: DemoStream uses GPU-accelerated batched TAMP to generate high-quality, learnable robot demonstrations without human teleoperation.
card.key_idea: Introduces batched conditional samplers and computation graph optimization to explore thousands of TAMP solutions in parallel, prioritizing task-space costs for unimodal demonstrations.
card.evaluation: Validated via simulation ablations and real-world tests (66 demos/hour), showing superior policy success rates over MimicGen and prior TAMP methods.
card.limitation: Relies on accurate physics models for planning; zero-cost or joint-space optimization yields zero policy success, requiring careful cost function tuning.

slides.title: Moxian Raises $1.49M for Tactile Sensors
slides.highlight: Moxian, a startup founded by a former DJI engineer, has raised $1.49M to develop tactile sensing technology, a critical component for enhancing robotic dexterity and human-robot interaction.

slides.title: Conditional Mean Flows: Few-Step Densities for Simulation-Based Inference
slides.highlight: Conditional mean flows enable tractable density evaluation and few-step sampling for simulation-based inference, significantly accelerating MCMC workflows by reducing inference costs while maintaining accuracy comparable to multi-step flow matching.

card.one_liner: Conditional mean flows enable few-step, tractable density evaluation for simulation-based inference, significantly accelerating MCMC sampling.
card.key_idea: Learns average velocities to define finite-time flow maps with exact Jacobian determinants, allowing single-step density evaluation without ODE integration.
card.evaluation: Benchmarked on two-moons, cognitive, epidemic, and g-and-k tasks against normalizing flows and flow matching using C2ST, NRMSE, and Hellinger distance.
card.limitation: Accuracy may degrade with excessive steps due to poor intermediate map training; transformer backbones incur higher per-evaluation costs than simpler flows.

slides.title: YYForce Brings Humanoid Robots to Hospitality in Landmark Partnership with Novotel & Mercure Singapore on Stevens
slides.highlight: This deployment of humanoid robots in a hospitality setting offers insights into real-world human-robot interaction and social engagement strategies relevant to embodied social robotics.

slides.title: Chinese startup DexForce trains humanoid robots using virtual data to slash costs
slides.highlight: DexForce's approach to training humanoid robots with virtual data offers a cost-efficient pathway for developing embodied agents, relevant to scaling RwB's human-robot interaction capabilities.

slides.title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
slides.highlight: This work introduces a streaming memory framework that internalizes historical context into evolving LoRA weights via a recurrent HyperNetwork, avoiding context competition between past and present observations. It demonstrates significant performance gains on streaming video benchmarks and generalizes to vision-language-action models.

card.one_liner: MaLoW internalizes streaming video history into evolving LoRA weights, avoiding context competition.
card.key_idea: A recurrent HyperNetwork incrementally updates fixed-size LoRA weights to encode history, separating memory from current input.
card.evaluation: Tested on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena; outperforms baselines by 3.9-11.8% with modest latency overhead.
card.limitation: Slightly underperforms some baselines on real-time perception splits; relies on specific HyperNetwork and SSM architectural choices.

slides.title: FF launches Nova humanoid robots and Physical AI programs
slides.highlight: The launch of Nova humanoid robots and Physical AI programs by FF introduces new developments in embodied AI that may inform the design and interaction capabilities of social robots within the RwB project.
